newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CNI sees $6.5 bln trade deficit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CNI sees $6.5 bln trade deficit in 1997.

text.p: Brazil's National Industry Confederation (CNI) said it expects a $6.5 billion trade deficit in 1997 after a gap of about $5.2 billion last year.

In a summary of a bulletin on foreign trade, the CNI said it expected current foreign exchange rate policy, which involves a gradual but slow devaluation of the real, to be maintained despite pressure for speedier depreciation.
"The actions of the monetary authorities in the foreign exchange market in December suggests the government will maintain its current foreign exchange rate policy in 1997," it said.
